scientific_integrity: Same mathematical model proof reconstruction and exact symbolic diagnostic through degree twelve; no independent validation or novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional real projective circle; strictly positive trigonometric-polynomial densities; minimal harmonic bandwidth. General arbitrary-order smeary-mean limits known previously. No proof for higher-dimensional Grassmannians.
title: Sharp Fourier bandwidth and positivity for high-order projective-circle Fréchet degeneracy
